traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are satisfied in the current codebase, even though the checkboxes in the story file have not been updated:
- Core Functionality: Implemented by src/index.ts plugin structure and validated by tests/plugin-setup.test.ts, tests/plugin-default-export-and-configs.test.ts, and tests/integration/cli-integration.test.ts (plugin loads, registers rules, and enforces them via ESLint CLI). - Quality Standards: The plugin follows standard ESLint plugin conventions (default export with rules/configs, peerDependency on eslint, TypeScript code compiled to lib, Jest-based tests) and is structured as a publishable npm package. - Integration with ESLint v9 flat config: Confirmed by eslint.config.js using flat config and by the CLI integration tests that run ESLint v9 CLI against this plugin and config. - User Experience: README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provide clear installation and configuration instructions, including multiple flat-config examples and quick start guidance. - Error Handling: Robust dynamic rule-load error handling is implemented in src/index.ts and thoroughly tested in tests/plugin-setup-error.test.ts and CLI error handling tests. - Documentation: Plugin purpose, installation, configuration, and development/test setup are well documented in README.md and user-docs, covering both end users and maintainers.
Given the concrete implementation and passing, traceable tests tied explicitly to this story, the story is fully implemented and should be marked complete.
